explore-value.title: Read the bands
explore-value.prompt: This resistor reads brown, black, brown: 100 Ω. Set the bands for 270 kΩ.
hints: Red = 2, violet = 7, and the multiplier with four zeros is yellow.
explore-value.success: Red, violet, yellow: 27 and four zeros, 270 kΩ. The third band is a multiplier, not a digit.

speed-round.title: Speed round
speed-round.prompt: Match five resistors in a row. Names are always shown next to the colours.
hints: Digits first, then count the zeros for the multiplier, then the tolerance band last.
speed-round.success: Five in a row. You can read the colour code.
